title: 2001 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Six trees are equally spaced along one side of a straight road. The distance from the first tree to the fourth is \(60\) feet. What is the distance in feet between the first and last trees?

solutions.text:
There are \(3\) gaps between the first and fourth trees, which means that one gap is \(60 \div 3 = 20\) feet long.

There are \(5\) gaps between the first and last trees. This means that they are \(5 \cdot 20 = 100\) feet apart.

Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: The first to fourth trees contain three equal gaps
The first to last trees contain five equal gaps
